result.topic_en: Riemann treats a minimal surface bounded by straight lines, chiefly the simplest case of two skew infinite lines; he maps the boundary to great circles on the sphere, finds that the surface is a helicoid (Schraubenfläche), and notes that the area integral is infinite and must be renormalised.

items.english: The straight lines must either intersect or go off to infinity, so that the surface between them extends to infinity.

senkrecht zu beiden Linien, und die pos. Nor-
male an dem einen Ende der pos. Lage[?]

items.english: At infinity the normal is likewise perpendicular to both lines, and the positive normal at one end is parallel to the positive direction, at the other end to the negative.
